verdict.rationale: Sentry's first-party Agents Dashboards cover the story's core. The LLM Calls view shows individual model requests and lets you compare models, token usage and cost. A Model Cost widget estimates spend from token usage and model pricing. A traces table lists total tokens, total cost and timestamp per run, which supports per-request, per-model and time-based views. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of cost/token aggregation over selectable time periods (only timestamps and dashboard widgets are evidenced), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see cost and token usage per request, model, and time period in dashboards

citations.quote: **LLM Calls** shows individual model requests. Use it to compare models, prompts, token usage, cost, and response performance
